items.text: I can explain what SDLC is and name all six phases in order
I can describe the Waterfall model and explain why it failed
I can explain Agile methodology and what a sprint is
I can articulate the gap between Agile and DevOps — what problem DevOps solves
I can clearly define Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, and Continuous Deployment — and state the difference between Delivery and Deployment
I can describe each tool in a CI/CD pipeline and its specific role (Jenkins, Maven, JUnit, SonarQube, JaCoCo, JFrog)
I can explain a complete CI/CD pipeline walkthrough — from code commit to production deployment
I can explain what a Quality Gate is and how it stops bad code from reaching production
I can explain the difference between Terraform (infrastructure provisioning) and Ansible (configuration management)
I understand what IaC (Infrastructure as Code) is and why it eliminates environment mismatch
I can answer: 'What is the difference between Continuous Delivery and Continuous Deployment?'
I can answer: 'What are the three main problems with the Waterfall model?'
I can answer: 'How do Agile and DevOps work together — what does each handle?'
I can identify from a scenario whether a team is using Continuous Delivery or Continuous Deployment
I can explain the 'Works on My Laptop' problem and which DevOps tool/practice fixes it
